source: SPECIFICATION.md AI/unbound rules; DESIGN.md section 7 and D11; PLAN.md Stage 8

checks.requirement: View-only deterministic wizard decisions; hidden-state equivalence and no provenance leaks
testNames: same permitted view and AI seed produce identical plans despite enemy secrets
hidden occupants do not change view-only decisions
private illusion knowledge, condition provenance and AI state never enter the opponent view
the pure policy accepts deeply frozen views and never mutates observations

checks.requirement: Bounded difficulty/search, normal legal commands, full content, fixed uncertain fallback and independent streams
testNames: %s difficulty uses the same permitted data and produces ordinary legal orders
all forty roster profiles receive legal bounded decisions from observed body capabilities
work exhaustion is explicit and never performs an unbounded search
cumulative session allowance %i preserves policy call bounds through restore
policy and AI submission leave setup and combat RNG untouched
all-player planning uses frozen observations rather than prior submitted orders or locks
uncertain rejected proposals use one fixed fallback without probing another target

checks.requirement: Independent nearest perceived different-species behavior, explicit ties, detours/flight/status and ordinary attacks
testNames: unbound creatures choose the nearest perceived different species including their former summoner
nearest-target ties consume only the explicit AI stream and persist the chosen identity
unbound perception cannot use another unit or the summoner to see an invisible target
a completely blocked unbound creature falls back to Total Defence
unbound flight can land to reach a ground target and retains its explicit transition through restore
known Early wake-up gives unbound units movement and Late attacks without an Early action

checks.requirement: Portable all-AI 2–8-player coordinator; real wins/draws, distinct limit/error outcomes and private failure capture
testNames: the %i-player unattended harness runs without changing wizard stats or inventing victory
a complete seeded close match reaches engine victory and reproduces exactly
a real simultaneous wizard death is reported as a draw
harness turn, work and atomic limits are timeouts, never invented wins or draws
unexpected engine errors are captured as failures with the last valid private snapshot

checks.requirement: Fresh-instance continuation, ordinary command replay, corruption rejection and explicit schema-26 migration
testNames: recorded ordinary commands and AI-stream transitions reproduce a complete match without rerunning policy
fresh session restoration at every planning and engine boundary preserves continuation
permanent %s session resumes deterministically in a fresh coordinator
schema-26 %s migration preserves committed work without autonomous replanning
malformed policy sessions and corrupted outcomes are rejected transactionally

checks.requirement: Reproducible tournament smoke with wins/draws/timeouts/failures separated

remaining: Stage 10 acceptance, visual, browser-matrix, performance and soak hardening
